metadata.description: Public Claude Code plugins by vcth4nh

plugins.name: codex-exec
plugins.description: Consult OpenAI Codex as a discussion peer — second opinions and multi-turn debate via codex exec/resume, delegation only when trusted. One skill, no scripts, no hooks, no state.

plugins.name: anti-slop
plugins.description: Remove AI-slop tone from prose. Two skills: deslop for engineering prose (docs, commits, PRs, READMEs) and academic-voice for paper prose with per-repo voice matching. Ships an opt-in ASD-STE100 output style.

plugins.name: leak-check
plugins.description: Audit public-facing text for internal-context leaks before it ships — paths, run IDs, infra names, private provenance, dev-log narrative, unexpanded jargon. Inline audit for routine text; fresh-context external-reviewer agent with a BLOCK/PASS verdict for papers and release notes.
